questions.question_text: In a computer-based exam, can candidates use personal scratch paper for the writing section?
options: Yes, as long as it is blank.
No, candidates are not permitted to bring personal paper or pencils.
Yes, but only if the invigilator inspects it first.
Only for the writing section, not the reading section.
questions.explanation: In computer-based tests, candidates are prohibited from bringing their own scratch paper or pencils; a draft area is provided in the software.

questions.question_text: What happens if you record exam questions or answers during the writing section?
options: It is encouraged as a learning tool.
The examiner will allow you to continue if you pay a fine.
The examiner will terminate your exam and your results will be invalidated.
You can only do this if you are a research student.
questions.explanation: Copying, photographing, or recording test questions is considered a violation, which leads to immediate termination of the exam.

questions.question_text: In a computer-based exam, can you use personal scratch paper for the writing section?
questions.explanation: For computer-based exams, bringing paper or pencils is prohibited; drafting is handled via the system.

questions.question_text: What is the penalty for recording exam questions during the writing section?
questions.explanation: Copying, recording, or removing test questions is considered a severe violation leading to test termination.

questions.question_text: How do you log in to the computer-based writing section?
options: The admission ticket and a specific password
questions.explanation: Candidates log in using the credentials provided by the invigilator for that specific session.

questions.question_text: What is forbidden regarding the online password for the exam?
questions.explanation: Exchanging passwords or logging into another's account is strictly prohibited and treated as proxy testing.

questions.question_text: What must be done with provided scratch paper after a paper-based writing test?
options: Take it home as a souvenir
Hand it back to the invigilator
questions.explanation: All scratch paper must be returned to ensure security of exam materials.
